user_prompt: What is the effect of peripherally inserted central catheters (PICCs) without a valve, compared with PICCs with integrated valve technology (proximal or distal valves), on catheter occlusion in people of any age requiring a PICC? Measurement: number of participants (or catheters) with catheter occlusion during the catheter dwell time, analysed as a dichotomous outcome with the no-valve group as the intervention and the valved group as the comparator. If a trial has more than one valved-catheter arm, combine them. Do not pool catheter failure, venous thromboembolism, infection, breakage or any other outcome, and do not include comparisons of catheter material, tip design or taper alone.
